capabilities.purpose: Upload once; issue a private stable document handle; reuse authorized extraction across sessions.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Content hashing, tenant isolation, immutable versions, upload limits, deletion and expiry.

capabilities.purpose: Report page count, scan/text coverage, encryption, signatures, forms, attachments and processing requirements.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Page-level coverage and explicit unknown states; inspection itself stays resource-bounded.

capabilities.purpose: List sections, bookmarks, tables and figures so the agent chooses where to look.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Distinguish embedded bookmarks from inferred headings and preserve correct page ranges.

capabilities.purpose: Return small cited snippets using exact, phrase and lexical search before optional semantic search.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Explicit coverage, ranked results, stable locations, bounded results and no false absence claims.

capabilities.purpose: Retrieve selected pages, sections or blocks as text, spatial text, Markdown or JSON.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Original spans remain available; truncation and cursors explicit; reading order checked.

capabilities.proposed_execution: PDF renderer service or CPU job
capabilities.purpose: Provide a page or bounded crop for visual verification without rendering the whole file.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Rotation and crop coordinates correct; DPI and pixel limits; private resource by default.

capabilities.purpose: Quote processing mode, selected pages, output limits and application charge ceiling before work.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Request/document binding, quote expiry, atomic budget reservation and explicit fallback policy.

capabilities.proposed_execution: OCR provider or isolated CPU job
capabilities.purpose: OCR only selected or demonstrably unreadable pages; cache the result for future reads.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Mixed native/scan PDFs, languages, abstention, page evidence and no unauthorized premium fallback.

capabilities.purpose: List tables, then extract selected ones with spans, units, original cells and source boxes.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Headers and merged cells correct; missing versus zero preserved; continuation joins marked.

capabilities.purpose: Filter, aggregate and compare extracted values without model arithmetic or full-table context.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Typed operations, exact source cells, unit/currency checks and deterministic numeric results.

capabilities.purpose: Return changed clauses, paragraphs and table cells across revisions, with both source locations.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Page insertions and reflow do not masquerade as semantic changes; never imply legal equivalence.

capabilities.purpose: Check generated files for expected content, render problems and suspicious clipping or omissions.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Structural, content, visual and standards findings remain separate; no blanket correctness guarantee.

capabilities.purpose: Return only requested JSON fields, with evidence, nulls and validation errors.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Schema validity separated from factual correctness; absent/unreadable fields are not guessed.

capabilities.proposed_execution: Cached source spans + optional semantic model
capabilities.purpose: Resolve exact quotations and references to their source page and immutable document version.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Exact matching distinct from semantic support and source truth; quote context preserved.

capabilities.purpose: Bundle selected snippets, crops, tables and a source manifest into a reviewable packet.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Source hashes, page labels, transformation history and consistent cited locations.

capabilities.purpose: Return relevant passages and selected table slices in one budgeted call rather than many agent round trips.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Source locations, neighboring qualifications and units retained; output budget and partial coverage explicit.

capabilities.purpose: Expose actual field names, types, current values and permitted choices before filling.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Distinguish AcroForm, XFA and flattened documents; unsupported formats explicit.

capabilities.purpose: Fill selected interactive fields from structured data and optionally flatten the result.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Appearance streams visible, values read back, choice validation and signature-change warning.

capabilities.purpose: Extract review comments, highlights and their anchored text for an agent to address.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Comment author/date treated as document metadata; locations and unresolved replies preserved.

capabilities.purpose: Retrieve selected embedded pictures and metadata rather than screenshotting every page.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Image IDs, page occurrence and captions retained; deduplication does not lose placement.

capabilities.purpose: Describe a chosen diagram, legend or visual element with an explicit evidence crop.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Distinguish observed labels from interpretation and abstain on unreadable details.

capabilities.purpose: Convert selected charts into approximate data with axes, units and source evidence.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Mark estimated versus exact values; test logarithmic axes, legends and uncertainty.

capabilities.purpose: Read a chosen formula as LaTeX with surrounding definitions and source location.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Subscripts, symbols and equation numbers checked; no claim of mathematical validity.

capabilities.purpose: Follow references to sections, tables, figures, appendices and footnotes inside a document.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Broken references reported; physical page index and printed labels remain distinct.

capabilities.purpose: Repair column sequencing, repeated headers and hyphenation while retaining original spans.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Normalization reversible through source links; footnotes and numbers not silently discarded.

capabilities.purpose: Flag sparse, garbled, mismatched or incomplete extraction and propose the cheapest next step.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Quality flags are calibrated separately; partial coverage and backend failures visible.

capabilities.purpose: Find relevant passages across an authorized set of PDFs without loading every document.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Per-result access control, corpus coverage and document/version provenance.

capabilities.purpose: Find identical or near-duplicate documents to avoid repeat processing and review.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Byte identity separate from similarity; private cross-tenant existence is not disclosed.

capabilities.purpose: Process only changed pages/regions when a new document revision arrives.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Cache invalidation includes resources, engine settings and dependencies, not just page text.

capabilities.purpose: Split, merge, reorder, rotate and select pages from structured instructions.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Internal links, forms, bookmarks, page labels and signature consequences checked.

capabilities.purpose: Reduce storage or transfer size with a declared quality policy and output comparison.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Compression is not advertised as guaranteed token savings; small text and barcodes preserved.

capabilities.purpose: Attempt bounded repair of damaged cross-references and streams and report changes.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Repair success separate from safe content, correct rendering or recovered information.

capabilities.purpose: Add a searchable text layer to scanned pages while retaining their visual appearance.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Text aligns to images; original retained; signatures and OCR mistakes explicitly handled.

capabilities.purpose: Add highlights, comments, labels and source-linked markup to selected locations.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Coordinates correct after rotation/cropping; originals and existing comments preserved.

capabilities.purpose: Remove selected sensitive content rather than covering it with a black rectangle.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Defined checks for text, images, attachments, metadata and revisions; unsupported content fails.

capabilities.purpose: Remove declared active content and embedded items under a documented sanitization policy.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Manifest lists removals; no absolute malware-free guarantee or implied preservation of signatures.

capabilities.purpose: Process an authorized encrypted PDF using the password supplied for that job.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: No password cracking; passwords never logged or persisted unnecessarily; failure modes explicit.

capabilities.purpose: Report integrity, signed revisions, permitted changes, certificate trust and timestamps separately.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Signature image detection is not cryptographic validation; unavailable revocation status remains unknown.

capabilities.proposed_execution: External protected signer + PDF signature library
capabilities.purpose: Prepare and sign a document using a caller-controlled secure signing integration.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: No private key custody in agent context; explicit signing intent and document hash confirmation.

capabilities.purpose: Create an archival variant and return the exact profile and validation report.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Retain original, inspect visual changes and do not label arbitrary PDFs archival without validation.

capabilities.proposed_execution: Structure/standards checker + human review where needed
capabilities.purpose: Report tags, reading order, language, alt text and table-accessibility findings.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Machine checks distinguished from human checks; no universal accessibility certification.

capabilities.purpose: Translate chosen sections into a parallel or newly laid-out artifact with source alignment.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Original preserved; numbers, names and units checked; layout and translation claims separated.

capabilities.purpose: Create reusable summaries for selected sections with citations and explicit coverage.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Extracted facts distinguished from model summary; full-document review is not implied.

capabilities.purpose: Identify deadlines, obligations and follow-up items with owner/date evidence.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Quoted source dates preserved; ambiguous deadlines and inference marked rather than invented.

capabilities.purpose: Extract line items and totals, preserve tax/currency evidence and flag arithmetic inconsistencies.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Line-item provenance, duplicate checks, rounding policies and unseen-template tests.

capabilities.purpose: Extract statement rows and reconcile opening balance, transactions and closing balance.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: No silent inferred transactions; signs, currency, dates and source rows preserved.

capabilities.purpose: Read checkboxes, labels and handwritten fields from a selected flat form.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Unchecked versus unreadable separate; confidence and required-field abstention tested.

capabilities.purpose: Compare technical datasheets by requested properties, units and source evidence.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Part variants, conditions, tolerances and missing specifications do not disappear in normalization.

capabilities.purpose: Convert a resume into a requested profile schema without invented employment facts.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Timeline evidence preserved; ambiguous dates remain ambiguous; no automated hiring judgment.

capabilities.purpose: Compare requested clause topics across documents with exact excerpts and missing/unknown states.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: No legal advice or equivalence guarantee; partial search and interpretive labels explicit.

capabilities.purpose: Decode relevant machine-readable codes without model visual guessing.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Return location and exact bytes; URLs are data and are not automatically opened.

capabilities.purpose: Safely inventory and retrieve embedded XML, CSV, spreadsheets and portfolio components.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Per-item limits, path normalization and provenance; no execution of attachments or macros.

capabilities.purpose: Evaluate formulas, detect errors and return targeted ranges as reusable evidence.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Calculation engine and unsupported functions declared; formula text separated from cached values.

capabilities.purpose: Apply structured changes and return a reviewable Word file with comments or tracked revisions.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: True revision structure, preserved styles and rendered verification rather than regex replacement.

capabilities.purpose: Convert DOCX, PPTX or XLSX to PDF or previews without requiring agent GUI automation.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Fonts, page/slide/sheet coverage, print areas and missing dependencies reported.

capabilities.purpose: Expose slide text, notes, images and targeted visual checks without whole-deck screenshots.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Hidden slides, notes and reading order explicit; selected checks do not certify the whole deck.

capabilities.purpose: Capture a requested page as readable text, screenshot or PDF with URL/time/hash evidence.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Controlled fetch policy, render limits and source identity; snapshot is not proof of website truth.

capabilities.purpose: Turn supplied email files and attachments into a searchable evidence packet.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Headers and attachments remain traceable; ingest only, with no automatic email sending.

capabilities.purpose: Validate JSON/CSV-like records, dates, units and business totals before an agent acts on them.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Precise error locations, named locale/rounding policies and no silent coercion.

capabilities.purpose: Turn structured data into SVG/PNG/PDF charts without agent plotting setup.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Source data retained, units/axes correct, readable rendering and no fabricated values.

capabilities.purpose: Inventory and retrieve selected files from a document archive without expanding everything.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Nested archive/decompression/path limits; no execution and per-file source manifest.

capabilities.purpose: Expose searchable transcript segments and selected timestamps for recordings linked to documents.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Speaker attribution uncertainty, language, consent/context policy and timestamp accuracy tested.

capabilities.purpose: Generate Mermaid, Graphviz or similar diagrams from structured input for reports.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Syntax diagnostics, bounded rendering and SVG safety; no arbitrary script execution.

capabilities.purpose: Deskew, rotate, crop and normalize selected scan images before OCR.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Original preserved; transformation coordinates and interpolation loss reported.

capabilities.purpose: Generate consistent reports, invoices or packets from structured data without repeating HTML/CSS in agent context.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Versioned templates and fonts; input schema validation; expected-content checks; reproducible source manifest.

capabilities.proposed_execution: Versioned source store + structured patch + renderer
capabilities.purpose: Make small edits to retained Markdown or template data and rerender without resending or rewriting the whole document.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Base-version conflict detection; stable block/field references; diff and page-scoped QA; no arbitrary PDF-editing promise.

capabilities.purpose: Generate many documents from validated records with one template and a bounded execution budget.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Per-record status and artifacts; isolated failures; idempotent retries; bounded concurrency and actual usage.

capabilities.purpose: Reconstruct an editable document or structured source from a PDF when the original source is unavailable.
capabilities.acceptance_focus: Fidelity report; text/image/table provenance; reconstructed versus preserved structure explicit; no exact-layout guarantee.
